pageDescription: Have your say: the open polls and the results of past ones.
pollDescription: Vote and see the results of this poll.
noPolls: No poll yet. Come back soon!
needScript: To vote, turn on JavaScript in your browser.
msg_closed: This poll is over, thanks for your interest.
msg_already: You already voted in this poll, thank you!
msg_limit: Too many tries at once. Wait a minute and try again.
msg_invalid: Your choice could not be counted. Reload the page and try again.
msg_net: The vote could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
msg_busy: The site is busy. Try again in a moment.
msg_full: This poll has reached its maximum number of voters.
msg_thanks: Thank you, your vote is saved!
msg_pick: Tick at least one choice before voting.
noEnd: No end date: the poll stays open until it is closed.
adminEmpty: You have no poll yet. Fill in the form below: a question, a few choices, and you are set. The link to share appears right after.
fQuestionHelp: Example: Which game do we play on Saturday? (140 characters at most)
fChoicesHelp: 2 to 8 choices, each on its own line. Example: Hollow Knight, Celeste, Hades.
fMaxHelp: 1 = a single choice (simplest). Use 2, 3… to let people tick several answers.
fResultsHelp: Either way, everyone sees the final result when the poll is over.
fEndDateHelp: Leave empty for a poll with no end: you will close it yourself. Time read in this zone: {zone}.
fEndTimeHelp: Example: 21:00. Without a time, the poll ends at 23:59.
err_question: Write the question, for example: Which game do we play on Saturday?
err_few: You need at least {min} choices, each on its own line. Example: Hollow Knight, then Celeste on the next line.
err_many: There are too many choices: {max} at most. Remove a few.
err_max: Write a whole number from 1. Example: 1 for a single choice.
err_maxHigh: People cannot tick more choices than there are. Use a smaller number.
err_end_date: Write a date that exists, as YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-03.
err_end_time: Write the time like this: 21:00 (from 00:00 to 23:59).
err_end_past: This date has already passed. Pick a moment in the future.
err_end_far: The end is too far away: pick a date within the coming year.
errFull: The site keeps {n} polls and none is finished yet. Close or delete one before creating another.
errNotClosed: Close the poll first, then archive it.
errPurged: The detailed votes of this poll have already been erased (retention period): it can no longer be reopened or recounted.
okCreated: Poll created and open. Here is its link to share.
okClosed: Poll closed: the final result is shown.
okReopened: Poll reopened, with no end date.
okArchived: Poll archived: only the totals are kept.
okOnAir: This poll is now shown on screen.
okAuto: The screen shows the most recent open poll again.
okRegen: New address created. Paste it into OBS: the old one no longer works.
actCopy: Make a new poll like this one
confirmClose: Yes, close this poll: nobody will be able to vote any more.
confirmReopen: Yes, reopen this poll with no end date.
confirmArchive: Yes, archive: detailed votes are erased, only totals remain.
confirmDelete: Yes, delete this poll and its results for good.
choicesLocked: {n} people have already voted: the choices can no longer change. For other choices, make a new poll from this one.
ballotsKept: Detailed votes (with no name at all) are erased {days} days after the poll ends; the totals remain.
ballotsGone: The detailed votes have been erased; the totals remain.
noPage: This module has no public page: give it an address in the settings to get a link.
archivedCount: {n} archived polls (they remain visible in the public list of finished polls).
limitsText: One vote per person relies on a private code kept in the browser: someone who clears their data, switches browser or votes in a private window can vote again. The site slows abuse down (limits per connection, per minute and per poll) but cannot stop all of it. For anything important (contest, prize draw), do not rely on this result alone.
obsHelp: In OBS, add a "Browser" source and paste the address below. Results appear on a transparent background and update by themselves, without overloading the site.
obsSecret: This address is secret: it shows the results even when the public cannot see them. Do not share it. Use this one: the address without a code (the one the site sometimes shows at the top of the module page) only shows a message.
obsOnAir: On screen: "{question}". To pick another, open its details then "Show on screen".
obsAuto: The screen automatically shows the most recent open poll.
obsRegenConfirm: Yes, the old address will stop working
obsRegenHelp: Do this if someone else has seen the address.
obsNoRight: You are not allowed to see the secret address of the OBS display. Ask the site owner.
errRight: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the site owner.
obsIncomplete: Incomplete address: copy the full address from the "On screen" tab of Polls, in the admin area.
